summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the purchase of 20,000,000 ordinary shares on 7 May 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 98.8997 pence per share, representing an ongoing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares were acquired from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled, resulting in a permanent reduction in share count. The buyback is part of the company's capital return strategy. Investors should monitor the pace of purchases and the impact on earnings per share; no premium, advisor, or board recommendation is noted.
